newsitem.title: UK: Wlm Morrison 5-week sales up 1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wlm Morrison 5-week sales up 1.2 pct.

text.p: British supermarket chain Wiliam Morrison Supermarkets Plc said on Monday sales excluding petrol in the five weeks to January 5, 1997 rose by 1.2 percent.
The company said petrol sales were down 13 percent while low-duty cross-Channel imports and tough domestic competition hit sales of wines and spirits.
Food sales were in line with budget and fresh produce volumes increased although retail prices for this sector were generally lower than a year ago, Morrison said.
Morrison said year-to-date sales for 48 weeks were up seven percent from the year-earlier period. Excluding petrol sales, takings were up 7.9 percent.
